data.one_liner: A Dart library for performing OSM Nominatim forward and reverse geocoding searches.
data.what_it_does: It wraps the OpenStreetMap Nominatim API, allowing you to search locations by name or coordinates. The API calls are made via HTTP and return structured results with optional address details, extra tags, and name details.
use_when: You need lightweight geocoding without a full mapping SDK
You want direct control over Nominatim query parameters
Your app runs on multiple platforms (mobile, web, desktop)
avoid_when: You require offline geocoding or caching of results
You need advanced map rendering or interactive map widgets
strengths: Simple, zero‑dependency wrapper around the Nominatim API
Supports both forward and reverse searches with detailed options
weaknesses: Relies on external Nominatim service and its rate limits
No built‑in caching or request throttling

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides the same low‑level HTTP capabilities; you can manually call Nominatim endpoints without an extra wrapper
